results.label: Buyer signs in with seeded email/password through UI
An expired recovery link cannot offer to change the existing project account password
A normal project login and a missing recovery link never expose a password-change form
Real local recovery email opens the named recovery account without replacing the project login
A validated recovery survives reload in its tab without using the unrelated project session
Switching the project account in another tab cannot retarget the open recovery form
Reusing an actual consumed link invalidates an older recovery session without falling back to the project account
An isolated failed password update reports failure and leaves the actual old password valid
Real password update remains successful when isolated logout fails; only the named recovery account changes
Completed recovery clears its tab credentials while the unrelated project login still restores
Recovery boundary acceptance has no external browser requests or uncaught page errors
